title: Marketing website: Updates and Agent Zoo
description:
**As a** visitor to chattic.us, **I want** two in-repo news desks — Updates (Chatticus progress) and Agent Zoo (the peer-product beat) — **so that** I can follow the product and the category from the marketing site, without a CMS.

This pass is **structure only**. No first posts. Adding a markdown file under `web/content/blog/{category}/` later is enough to publish.

## Locked names

- Public category names: **Updates** and **Agent Zoo**.
- Agent Zoo is Chatticus's name for the desk. "Model zoo", "bot farm", "software factory", "reactor chamber", and next week's coinage are industry jargon the desk *covers*. They are not the blog's name and they are not Chatticus product names.

## Definition of Done

- Footer News group lists Updates, then Agent Zoo, at `/updates` and `/agent-zoo`.
- Both indexes ship with a real masthead and an empty article list. No "coming soon."
- `web/content/blog/AGENTS.md` is the news-desk editor guide; root `AGENTS.md` points at it.
- A markdown loader at build time (`web/lib/blog.ts`) is the seam for later moving content.
- `[slug]` post templates exist with `generateStaticParams`. Zero posts emit nothing.
- `features/marketing_blog.feature` is green via the marketing UI harness.
- No header nav, RSS, sitemap expansion, or first posts.

## Out of scope

First posts, RSS, sitemap, CMS, header links.
